services.desc: The Westport Community TV filmed our Tuesdays with WAG presentation with Rick Paulus. The Periwinkle Shop features small art items, handcrafted gifts and small wall-hung works made by our members, and is located in the Westport Art Group lobby. The Periwinkle Shop is open during classes, exhibits, and by appointment at 1740 Main Road, Westport Point, MA. One of the perks of WAG membership is being able to sell your artwork and handmade original items in the Periwinkle Gift Shop - and you’re invited to participate! blurb: Westport Art Group was formed in 1955 by a small group of local, art-minded women. Since then, we have grown into a robust and colorful community organization approaching 250 members from all over South Coast, Massachusetts, southern Rhode Island, and beyond.
